name: Ookubo Taichi
source:
He's a physical fitness freak who takes pride in his muscular body.
On the surface, he pretends to be a kind and polite coach, but he also has a strong libido and enjoys casually touching the bodies of the students who come to learn from him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
